name: Haunted Gnome
prerequisites: Cha 13, gnome magic racial trait, Knowledge (arcana) 1 rank
benefit:
You add haunted fey aspect (page 230) to your list of gnome magic spell-like abilities, and you can use this spell-like ability twice per day.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 122
You can spend 5 stamina points to use haunted fey aspect an additional time in a day.
flavor: You use your gnome magic to take on an eerie illusory appearance.
